record.original_question: For a compact Kahler manifold (X, omega) and a probability measure mu, determine whether the following are equivalent: first, there exists epsilon_mu > 0 such that exp(-epsilon_mu * PSH(X, omega)) is contained in L^1(mu); second, there exists a Holder continuous omega-plurisubharmonic function phi on X such that mu = MA(phi).

evidence.quote: Question 16 (DDGHKZ). Are the following properties equivalent ? (i) There exists epsilon_mu > 0 such that exp(-epsilon_mu PSH(X, omega)) subset L^1(mu). (ii) There exists phi in Hol(X, omega) such that mu = MA(phi).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\omega)$ be a compact Kähler manifold of complex dimension $n$, and let $\mathrm{PSH}(X,\omega)$ denote the set of $\omega$-plurisubharmonic functions on $X$, i.e. upper semicontinuous functions $u:X\to[-\infty,\infty)$, $u\not\equiv-\infty$, such that $\omega+dd^c u\ge 0$ as a current. For a bounded $\omega$-plurisubharmonic function $\varphi$, the Monge–Ampère measure is defined (in the sense of Bedford–Taylor) by
$$\mathrm{MA}(\varphi)=(\omega+dd^c\varphi)^n.$$
A function $\varphi\in\mathrm{PSH}(X,\omega)$ is called Hölder continuous if it is Hölder continuous as a function on $X$; denote the class of such functions by $\mathrm{Hol}(X,\omega)$.

Let $\mu$ be a probability measure on $X$. Consider the following two properties:

(i) There exists $\varepsilon_\mu>0$ such that for every $u\in\mathrm{PSH}(X,\omega)$ normalized by $\sup_X u=0$, one has $e^{-\varepsilon_\mu u}\in L^1(\mu)$, with a uniform bound depending only on $\mu$ and $\varepsilon_\mu$ (equivalently, $\exp(-\varepsilon_\mu\,\mathrm{PSH}(X,\omega))\subset L^1(\mu)$).

(ii) There exists $\varphi\in\mathrm{Hol}(X,\omega)$ such that $\mu=\mathrm{MA}(\varphi)$.

Determine whether (i) and (ii) are equivalent.
artifact.status_search_result: The implication (ii) ⇒ (i) is classical (Hölder potentials yield uniformly exponentially integrable measures via Skoda-type estimates). The reverse direction (i) ⇒ (ii) is the substantive part. A characterization of Hölder Monge–Ampère measures via Hölder continuity of the super-potential was obtained by Dinh–Nguyen–Sibony and refined by Dinh–Guedj–Kolodziej and others, but the precise equivalence with the simple exponential-integrability condition (i) does not appear to have been established in full generality. No published resolution of this exact equivalence was found, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Characterization of Monge-Ampère measures with Hölder continuous potentials
status_evidence.snippet: The complex Monge-Ampere equation on a compact Kaehler manifold admits a Hölder continuous omega-psh solution if and only if its right-hand side is a positive measure with Hölder continuous super-potential.
status_evidence.claim: Provides a characterization in terms of Hölder continuous super-potentials, not directly in terms of the exponential-integrability condition (i).

status_evidence.title: Hölder continuous solutions of the Monge–Ampère equation on compact Hermitian manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Studies sufficient conditions on measures (domination by capacity, moderate measures) ensuring existence of Hölder continuous solutions.
status_evidence.claim: Existing sufficient conditions for (ii) involve capacity domination/moderate measures rather than the exponential integrability condition stated in (i).
